CLAT Admission Online Form 2026 - Complete Details

CLAT Admission Online Form 2026. Eligible candidates can apply online through the official website before the last date. The last date to apply is 31/10/2026. Check important dates, application fee, eligibility criteria and official links below.

Important Dates

  • Start Date : 03/08/2026
  • Last Date : 31/10/2026
  • Last Date Pay : 31/10/2026
  • Exam City Available Date : As Per Schedule
  • Admit Card Released Date : As Per Schedule
  • Exam Date : 06/12/2026
  • Result Declared Date : As Per Schedule
  • Exam Name : Conducted By

Application Fee

  • Start Date : 03/08/2026
  • Last Date : 31/10/2026
  • Last Date Pay : 31/10/2026
  • General / OBC / EWS : Rs. 4000/-
  • SC / ST : Rs. 3500/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
